sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Gaurav Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
453 of 2023 at Police Station-Turkpatti, District- Kushinagar under Sections 376, 323, 504, 506 IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 14.01.2024.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 16.02.2024.

The following arguments made by Shri Gaurav Kumar Singh, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail.
1. The victim and the applicant were intimate and they had consensual physical relations.

sentences.text: 2. The F.I.R. is the result of opposition of the victim's family to the said relationship.
3. However, the victim was married off to another person by her family.
The relationship of the applicant and the victim was revealed by some inimical parties to the husband of the victim.
This created a breach in the matrimonial relations of the victim with her husband and led to the lodgement of the FIR.
The FIR has been lodged to deflect attention from the conduct of the victim.
4. Medical evidence to corroborate commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.
5. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from the instant case.
6. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Praduman Kushwaha be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(iii) The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement passed by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru.
Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. (Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).

sentences.text: The learned trial court shall ensure that the right of bail of the applicant granted by this Court is not frustrated by arbitrary demands of sureties or onerous conditions which are unrelated to the socioeconomic status of the applicant.
(iv) The applicant is restrained from contacting the victim personally, indirectly by telephone or any other device.
In case, the applicant breaches the conditions of bail, the victim may make an application before the trial court.
The trial court shall take appropriate action upon receipt as per law which shall include cancellation of bail.
